correctness.rationale: Translation by \((1,1)\) partitions \(\mathbb F_q^2\) into orbits of length \(p\). On one orbit write \(\psi(a_0+i,b_0+i)=z_i+i\). The synchronizer condition becomes \(z_{i+1}\ne z_i\) cyclically, while the two forbidden output values leave \(q-1\) available colors on diagonal orbits and \(q-2\) on off-diagonal orbits. The number of proper colorings of a \(p\)-cycle with \(r\) colors is \(P_p(r)=(r-1)^p+(-1)^p(r-1)\). There are \(q/p\) diagonal orbits and \(q(q-1)/p\) off-diagonal orbits, giving the stated product. Positivity of the off-diagonal factor yields existence exactly for \(q\ge4\); at \(q=4\), the formula gives \(2304\).
